content:
The script failed to correctly format age notes and failed to remove layout cache elements from modified paragraphs.
Assertion error in test_required_values_present_and_repeated_value_updated indicates the string '1990-11-02 (35세)' was missing, likely due to an age calculation mismatch. The test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache failed because <hp:linesegarray> elements persisted in modified paragraphs. The remove_line_seg_arrays function likely failed due to incorrect namespace handling or incomplete targeting of modified <hp:p> elements.
